splits.held-out shape (time halves): The shape is fitted on the first half of the track in time and scored on the second half, then the reverse, so drift of the hand's size between the halves (half_span_ratio) counts as error.
splits.held-out shape (interleaved frames): The shape is fitted on the even-indexed frames of the track and scored on the odd-indexed ones, then the reverse, so every frame is scored once but neighbouring frames share size and pose.

observability_settings.meaning: A rotation direction is weak at threshold t when its singular value in the Jacobian of the 20 wrist-relative landmarks with respect to the 48 rotation parameters is below t times the largest; weak_counts is the median number of weak directions over the sampled frames, and joint_weak_weight the trace of the weak projector at joint_weight_threshold over each joint's three parameters, averaged over the frames.
